subject: Re: Deployment mode & compliance — HIPAA/BAA, SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Alex Nguyen <alex@elarahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurements <procurements@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T15:12:00Z
Subject: Post-demo follow-up — deployment mode and compliance needs

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — it was helpful to see the latency and routing features in action. As we discussed, our security and compliance team is pushing us toward either a Dedicated capacity or a Private VPC deployment because we need a BAA in place and tighter controls on PHI access. A few follow-ups from our side: 

- Can you share Redwood's SOC 2 report (most recent) and a template/draft of your BAA?
- We need clarification on what audit evidence you can provide around access logs, key management (KMS/HSM), and data retention policies.
- Procurement would like a rough timeline and any carrier/cloud regions constraints for a Private VPC option.

CC'ing procurement to make sure they're looped in on timeline questions.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on another call if that helps.

Alex
Alex Nguyen
Senior IT Security, Elara Health
alex@elarahealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Procurements <procurements@elarahealth.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T17:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — deployment mode and compliance needs

Hi Alex — great speaking with you earlier. Recap and next steps below.

Recap of options (short):
- Hosted API: fastest to go live, no BAA available for PHI workflows — not recommended if you must process PHI.
- Dedicated capacity: Reserved GPU pools, enterprise tenancy and stronger isolation; we can support a BAA and provide SOC 2 report excerpts. Good fit if you want managed service with contractual commitments.
- Private VPC / On-prem: Full control, customer-managed network and KMS/HSM integration; best for strict audit requirements or regulation-driven deployments. Longer lead time and higher operational involvement.

Requested evidence we can provide:
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (most recent): attached (see Redwood_Soc2_Report_2025.pdf).
- BAA: we have a standard BAA template — attaching a draft we can tailor (will send updated version after your comments).
- Audit evidence we can share: access log configuration examples, trace-level retention policy, KMS integration notes (support for customer-managed CMKs), and summaries of our endpoint authorization flows. For deeper requests (e.g., copies of audit logs), we'll work through legal/procurement and an approved evidence request process.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll send the BAA draft and SOC2 report (attached) — you can share with security/procurement.
2) Dylan (cc'd) can run a short technical follow-up to cover KMS, logging, and deployment architecture for Private VPC if you want a deeper dive.
3) If procurement is comfortable, we can spin up a Dedicated capacity PO and start a SOC2-evidence exchange and BAA redline. Typical lead times: ~2–4 weeks for Dedicated onboarding after contract, 6–10 weeks for Private VPC depending on network approvals.

Attached: Redwood_Soc2_Report_2025.pdf (redacted for external sharing)

Let me know which option you want to prioritize and I'll coordinate the right folks.

Thanks,

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Phone: (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: Redwood_Soc2_Report_2025.pdf (pdf, 2.3MB)]

From: Alex Nguyen <alex@elarahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurements <procurements@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-23T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — deployment mode and compliance needs

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SOC2 report. A few clarifications from security and procurement after an initial read: 

- Security: they want confirmation that access logs are immutable for a 1-year retention window and that we can get filtered logs for our tenant (not aggregated). They also asked about support for customer-managed keys (we use AWS KMS CMKs).
- Procurement: noted the 2–4 week Dedicated onboarding estimate. For a Dedicated PO we need a BAA in place and a stub statement of work with milestones.

We are leaning toward Dedicated capacity to strike a balance between control and speed to production, but if the Private VPC timelines are acceptable and you support CMKs, we may request a Private option. Can Dylan set up a technical call next week to review logging/KMS specifics?

Also attaching a short procurement timeline we maintain so you can map dependencies.

Alex
[Attachment: Elara_Procurement_Timeline.pdf (pdf, 180KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Procurements <procurements@elarahealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-25T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up — deployment mode and compliance needs

Thanks Alex — that's helpful context. Quick answers and proposed next steps: 

- Access logs: we can provide tenant-scoped, queryable access logs with an immutable retention option configured for 1 year. For formal evidence we'll provide the logging configuration export and a sample redacted log extract through the evidence request process.
- KMS: Redwood supports AWS KMS CMKs for Dedicated and Private VPC deployments (customer-managed keys). For Hosted API we manage keys and do not support CMKs.
- BAA: attaching a tailored draft for Elara to start redlines (BAA_Draft_Elara_Redwood.docx). Please have legal/procurement send redlines back to me; we can also do a DocuSign flow once redlines are agreed.

Action items:
1) Dylan to schedule the technical deep-dive (logging + KMS) — suggested slots next Tue/Wed.
2) Procurement to confirm whether they want Redwood to proceed with a Dedicated PO or evaluate Private VPC by the end of next week.
3) I'll open a formal SOC2 evidence request ticket and share the intake link once procurement confirms.

Links/attachments included:
- BAA draft: BAA_Draft_Elara_Redwood.docx (attached)
- SOC2 report (attached in earlier message)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/98765
- Provisional DocuSign envelope: https://docu-sign.example.com/ELR-BAA-2026

If that plan sounds good I'll have Dylan reach out with available times.

Best,

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
